description: This file defines a JUnit5 extension class 'MainDispatcherExtension' that replaces the main coroutine dispatcher with a test dispatcher for deterministic unit testing, primarily used in Android and Kotlin coroutine test contexts.

classes.name: MainDispatcherExtension
classes.description: A JUnit5 extension that sets up and resets the main coroutine dispatcher for testing purposes. It uses a configurable test dispatcher by default.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets the main dispatcher to the provided test dispatcher before each test execution.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Resets the main dispatcher after each test execution.
